## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the smallest relevant tests.
- [ ] I ran `npm run lint`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run build`.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] This change contains no credentials, tokens, customer data, or private diagrams.
- [ ] Deployment and permission changes use least privilege.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visual changes, or write `Not applicable`.
